gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that withUseInput(null) produces a distinct Value instance that differs from the original in equality but retains the same non-null injection id.
ADDED i2: A non-null object serves as the injection id so that hasId() will return true.
ADDED i3: Build a Value with useInput=TRUE and optional=TRUE.
ADDED i4: Replacing useInput with null must return a brand-new instance (not the same reference) because the useInput field changes from TRUE to null.
ADDED i5: The two instances must be different objects.
ADDED i6: They must not be equal because their useInput fields differ (TRUE vs null).
ADDED i7: The injection id is unchanged, so the new Value still reports having an id.
